strings.jp:
その後彼はあまりの酒癖︀の悪さから
部下の信頼を失い、ひとり寂しく
砂漠で暮らしたという…
strings.en:
His drinking got so bad that he
lost his men's trust, and he
lived out his days alone in the
desert...

strings.jp:
その彼のあまりにも無軌道な戦い振りに
戦場は混乱し、乱戦を呼ぶ男として
敵味方を問わず恐れられたという…
strings.en:
His wild, lawless fighting threw
battles into chaos, and friend
and foe alike feared him as a
man who sparked brawls...

strings.jp:
終戦間もなくして軍を離れるも
彼は国一番の酒豪として多くの者たちから
恐れられたという…
strings.en:
He left the army soon after the
war, yet many still feared him
as the hardest drinker in the
land...

strings.jp:
酒代で国が傾くとまで言われた
その酒量により、彼の名は
世界中に轟いたという…
strings.en:
Folk said his bar tab could
bankrupt a nation, and his
drinking made his name known
worldwide...

strings.jp:
彼の操るその斧が唸りをあげるごとに
ひとつ、またひとつと
集落が壊滅していったという…
strings.en:
Each time his axe let out a roar,
one village after another was
wiped out...

strings.jp:
その斧の波動の凄まじさと
限度を超えた酒癖︀の悪さにより
軍隊ですら彼を避けて通ったという…
strings.en:
With his fearsome axe waves
and his drinking beyond all
limits, even armies went out of
their way to avoid him...

strings.jp:
彼はまさしく天下の大酒飲みだったが
他に目立った長所も無く、やがては
歴史の中に埋もれていった…
strings.en:
He truly was the world's
greatest drinker, but with no
other notable virtue, he was
soon buried by history...

strings.jp:
波乱万丈な生き方が彼の信条だったが
そのあまりに破天荒な生き様に
ついて行ける部下は少なかったという…
strings.en:
A wild, eventful life was his
creed, but few of his men could
keep up with a life that
reckless...

strings.jp:
抜いたヒゲの本数だけ悪さをする彼は
多くの者たちから厄病王として
恐れられたという…
strings.en:
Doing one bad deed for every
whisker he plucked, he was
feared by many as the Plague
King...

strings.jp:
数々の宿敵を屠り、
盗族の頂点に立った彼は、ついに
歴史に名を残す存在となった…
strings.en:
Having slain rival after rival
and risen to the top of all
bandits, he at last left his name
in history...

strings.jp:
酒も強く、腕力も強い彼はその後も
盗賊の道を究めるためにひたすら
精進を続けるのだった…
strings.en:
A strong drinker and a strong
fighter, he kept on training
single-mindedly to master the
way of the bandit...

strings.jp:
その傍若無人な振る舞いから、彼はいつしか
砂漠の悪夢と呼ばれ、その名は世界中に
轟いたという…
strings.en:
His outrageous ways earned
him the name Desert Nightmare,
and that name rang out across
the world...
